llm_response.reason: Public scam warnings identify fb-business.com as a phishing/technical support scam site spoofing Facebook/Meta Business support. It uses tactics mimicking legitimate company branding, urgent communication to panic users, and fake account-recovery messages, all to steal credentials or sensitive information. The 403 forbidden status suggests the site may block analysis or be partially taken down due to abuse, which is also typical for domains involved in widespread phishing campaigns.
